name: The Mark of Quality
summary: At Feathermoon Stronghold, the leatherworker Pratt McGrubben will not compromise on quality. Pratt has come across thick yeti hides and wants a stack of ten.

sections.title: Pratt's Philosophy
sections.body: Pratt McGrubben will not compromise on leatherwork: only the finest will do. While hunting for fine materials, Pratt came across thick yeti hides. The yetis are native to Feralas, with many around Feral Scar Vale, just inland of the Forgotten Coast.

sections.title: The Offer
sections.body: For a stack of ten hides, Pratt will let you choose one of the leather goods Pratt has crafted. Bring them back to Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: Pratt's Thoughts on the Hides
sections.body: Pratt asks whether you stopped to feel the texture of the hides. Properly treated, they could prove tougher than iron, and few people know of them. With a wide knowledge of treating solutions, Pratt hopes to make pieces that carry a true mark of quality.

faq.q: Who is asking for the hides?
aliases: who gives the mark of quality
faq.answer: Pratt McGrubben, a leatherworker at Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: Where can the yetis be found?
faq.answer: Yetis are native to Feralas, and many are found around Feral Scar Vale, just inland of the Forgotten Coast.

faq.q: How many hides does Pratt want?
faq.answer: Ten of them, as one stack.

faq.q: What do I get for the hides?
faq.answer: Pratt offers a choice among the leather goods Pratt has crafted, in exchange for the stack.
